headline: Buying homes with loans, buying stocks... household debt tops 2,000 trillion for the first time
summary: South Korea's household debt has exceeded 2,000 trillion won for the first time. Analysts link the rise to mortgage growth from higher housing transactions and to more credit loans and brokerage margin lending amid stock market volatility.
why: Household debt levels affect consumer spending, bank asset quality and the central bank's room to adjust interest rates.
